sv.title: Minst 44 dödade i attacker i Kongo-Kinshasa
sv.summary: I Kongo-Kinshasa har minst 44 personer dödats i attacker utförda av en grupp beväpnade personer med kopplingar till terrorrörelsen IS. Enligt AFP skedde attackerna tidigare i veckan i nordöstra delarna av landet.

en.title: At least 44 killed in attacks in DR Congo
en.summary: In DR Congo at least 44 people have been killed in attacks carried out by a group of armed individuals with links to the terrorist movement IS. According to AFP the attacks took place earlier in the week in the north-eastern parts of the country.
